_about: Conductor policy for the lead session. Read by tools/conductor/*.mjs. Change limits here, not in code. See enforcement for what is really enforced and by whom.

examples: choose the energy and length cap
merge worker output into the job
ask a person to approve a gate
run the director's checks and report pass or fail with numbers
find where a fact is recorded
confirm a file or number exists
build or change one scene from its shots.json brief
write and record a product capture script for one flow
critique moodboard frames, key frames or a contact sheet
study one reference video into a study card
fill product discovery sections with sourced facts

guided.about: The six approvals, one at a time.

grouped.about: One brief review (idea, script and moodboard decisions together), the storyboard folded into it when it suits, and a final cut review.

always_ask: an unresolved decision that changes the output
a brand requirement (logo, colour, font, claim, legal line)
asset rights (third-party logos, music, footage, reference material)
external transfer (upload, send, publish, share outside the folder)
paid usage (any generation or service that costs money)

max_active_workers.note: dispatch.mjs claim refuses a third active claim. Claude Code's own subagent limit is 20 (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS), so this only holds if the lead calls claim before every dispatch.

stage_dispatch_cap.note: dispatch.mjs claim refuses past the stage cap.

max_retries_per_task.note: dispatch.mjs claim refuses a second retry of the same stage and task.

write_set_overlap.note: dispatch.mjs claim refuses overlapping write paths. Declared paths only: it cannot stop a worker writing elsewhere.

model_allowlist.note: claim reads availableModels and refuses a blocked model; it never swaps it. Claude Code itself enforces availableModels on its side.

paid_requires_approval.note: claim --paid refuses without a valid paid_usage receipt. Direct tool calls that spend money are not intercepted.

gate_receipts.note: gate.mjs check reports missing, stale or satisfied. Nothing stops a session ignoring it.

agent_max_turns.note: Claude Code stops a subagent at the maxTurns field in its agent file (all six set it). The values here mirror those files; if they differ, the file wins.

agent_model.note: Claude Code applies the model frontmatter field.

spend_cap.note: No spend or token cap exists in interactive sessions. --max-budget-usd and --max-turns are print mode only. Track with usage and /usage.

token_budget.note: No enforced token cap. Tokens are recorded only when supplied with release --tokens.

always_ask.note: Session text only: the lead must ask a person.
